title: So‘roq gaplar tuzish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ha yoki yo‘q savollarini hamda who, what, where, when, why, how, how much bilan savollarni to‘g‘ri so‘z tartibida va ohangda tuzasiz, qisqa javob berasiz va yangi do‘stga o‘nta savol yozasiz.

scenes.title: So‘roq gaplar tuzish
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘n uchinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda kiyim, ranglar va do‘konda narx so‘rashni o‘rgandik. Bugun ingliz tilidagi eng muhim ko‘nikmalardan birini o‘rganamiz: to‘g‘ri savol tuzish. Dars oxirida ha yoki yo‘q bilan javob beriladigan savollarni ham, who, what, where kabi so‘roq so‘zlari bilan savollarni ham to‘g‘ri so‘z tartibida va to‘g‘ri ohangda bera olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we will learn how to make questions in English.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun ingliz tilida savollarni qanday tuzishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Savol uchun so‘z tartibi
board: You are a student. → Are you a student?
She is at home. → Is she at home?
I am late. → Am I late?
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida ha yoki yo‘q savolini “-mi” yuklamasi bilan tuzamiz: “Siz talabamisiz?” Inglizchada yuklama yo‘q. Buning o‘rniga so‘zlar o‘rnini almashtiramiz. Gapda “be” fe’li bo‘lsa, uni egadan oldinga o‘tkazamiz: you are a student, are you a student? She is at home, is she at home? I am late, am I late? Faqat tartib o‘zgaradi, yangi so‘z qo‘shilmaydi.
scenes.say: You are a student. Are you a student? She is at home. Is she at home? I am late. Am I late?
scenes.say_uz: Siz talabasiz. Siz talabamisiz? U uyda. U uydami? Men kechikdim. Men kechikdimmi?

scenes.title: Be bilan savollar: ko‘proq misollar
scenes.say_native: Yana misollar. They are teachers, are they teachers? It is cold, is it cold today? We are late, are we late? Ko‘rinib turibdiki, qoida hamma shaxs uchun bir xil. Savol belgisi gap oxiriga qo‘yiladi. Qisqa javob ham tayyor: Yes, I am. Yes, she is. No, we aren’t. Javobda to‘liq gapni takrorlash shart emas, “Yes, they are” yetarli.
scenes.say: Are they teachers? Yes, they are. Is it cold today? No, it isn't. Are we late? Yes, we are.
scenes.say_uz: Ular o‘qituvchilarmi? Ha, ular. Bugun sovuqmi? Yo‘q. Biz kechikdikmi? Ha.

scenes.title: Be bilan xatolar
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: tartibni o‘zgartirmasdan, faqat ohang bilan so‘rash: “You are a student?” Bunday savol, o‘zbekchadagi “Siz talabasizmi?” ga o‘xshab, hayratni bildiradi, oddiy savol uchun esa to‘g‘ri emas. Ikkinchisi: be fe’lining shaklini adashtirish, masalan “Is you…?” Fe’l egaga mos bo‘lishi kerak: am I, are you, is he, she, it, are we, are they.
scenes.say: Not: You are a student? Say: Are you a student? Not: Is you a student? Say: Are you a student?
scenes.say_uz: You are a student? emas. Are you a student? deng. Is you a student? emas. Are you a student? deng.

scenes.title: Savolga aylantiring
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Gaplarni savolga aylantiring. Birinchi: u shifokor. Ikkinchi: siz charchagansiz. Uchinchi: ular bog‘da. To‘rtinchi: u qimmat. Be fe’lini egadan oldinga qo‘ying va baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: He is a doctor. You are tired. They are in the park. It is expensive. Make questions.
scenes.say_uz: U shifokor. Siz charchagansiz. Ular bog‘da. U qimmat. Savol tuzing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: is he a doctor? Ikkinchi: are you tired? Uchinchi: are they in the park? To‘rtinchi: is it expensive? Har birida faqat ikki so‘z almashdi: be fe’li oldinga chiqdi. Hammasini to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, eng oddiy savol turini egalladingiz.
scenes.say: Is he a doctor? Are you tired? Are they in the park? Is it expensive?
scenes.say_uz: U shifokormi? Siz charchadingizmi? Ular bog‘damu? U qimmatmi?

scenes.title: Do bilan savollar
board: You like tea. → Do you like tea?
They live here. → Do they live here?
scenes.say_native: Gapda be fe’li bo‘lmasa, ya’ni boshqa fe’l bo‘lsa, savol uchun yordamchi fe’l “do” qo‘shamiz. You like tea, do you like tea? They live here, do they live here? Do gapning boshiga chiqadi, undan keyin ega, keyin asosiy fe’l o‘z shaklida turadi. I, you, we va they bilan “do” ishlatiladi. Bu yordamchi fe’l tarjima qilinmaydi, u faqat savol belgisi vazifasini bajaradi.
scenes.say: You like tea. Do you like tea? They live here. Do they live here? Do we start now?
scenes.say_uz: Siz choyni yoqtirasiz. Choy yoqadimi? Ular shu yerda yashaydi. Ular shu yerda yashaydimi? Hozir boshlaymizmi?

scenes.title: He, she, it bilan does
board: She likes music. → Does she like music?
scenes.say_native: He, she va it bilan “do” o‘rniga “does” ishlatamiz. Eng muhimi: does savolda -s qo‘shimchasini o‘ziga oladi, shuning uchun asosiy fe’l oddiy shaklda qoladi. She works, does she work? He likes music, does he like music? Fe’ldagi s tushib qoladi. Buni shunday eslab qoling: bitta s yetarli, ikkita s kerak emas.
scenes.say: She works here. Does she work here? He likes music. Does he like music? It opens at nine. Does it open at nine?
scenes.say_uz: U shu yerda ishlaydi. U shu yerda ishlaydimi? U musiqani yaxshi ko‘radi. U musiqani yaxshi ko‘radimi? U to‘qqizda ochiladi. U to‘qqizda ochiladimi?

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan solishtirish
board: Siz choy ichasizmi? → Do you drink tea?
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida savol yuklamasi “-mi” fe’ldan keyin, gap oxirida turadi: “Siz choy ichasizmi?” Inglizchada esa shunga o‘xshash vazifani “do” yoki “does” bajaradi, lekin u gap boshida turadi. Ruscha “ли” ga ham o‘xshaydi, lekin u ham boshqacha. Shuning uchun savolni boshdan o‘ylash kerak: avval yordamchi fe’l, keyin ega, keyin asosiy fe’l. Masalan, do you drink tea?
scenes.say: Do you drink tea? Does he drink tea? Do they drink tea?
scenes.say_uz: Siz choy ichasizmi? U choy ichadimi? Ular choy ichishadimi?

scenes.title: Does bilan xatolar
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi: does bilan fe’lga yana s qo‘yish, “does she works”. Yo‘q, does allaqachon s ni olgan. Ikkinchisi: he, she, it bilan do ishlatish, “do she work”. Uchinchisi: yordamchi fe’lni tashlab ketish, “You like tea?” Bu ham xuddi be bilan xato kabi. Savolning yuragi yordamchi fe’l ekanini eslang.
scenes.say: Not: Does she works? Say: Does she work? Not: Do she work? Say: Does she work?
scenes.say_uz: Does she works emas. Does she work deng. Do she work emas. Does she work deng.

scenes.title: Do yoki does?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta savol bor. Har birining boshiga do yoki does ni qo‘ying va savolni to‘liq ayting. Birinchi: siz inglizcha gapirasizmi. Ikkinchi: u Toshkentda yashaydimi. Uchinchi: ular futbol o‘ynaydimi. To‘rtinchi: u qahva ichadimi. Fe’l shakliga ham e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Do or does? You speak English. He lives in Tashkent. They play football. She drinks coffee. Make the questions.
scenes.say_uz: Do yoki does? Siz inglizcha gapirasiz. U Toshkentda yashaydi. Ular futbol o‘ynaydi. U qahva ichadi. Savollarni tuzing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: do you speak English? Ikkinchi: does he live in Tashkent? Uchinchi: do they play football? To‘rtinchi: does she drink coffee? Yodda tuting, you va they bilan do, he va she bilan does, va asosiy fe’l hamma joyda s siz: speak, live, play, drink.
scenes.say: Do you speak English? Does he live in Tashkent? Do they play football? Does she drink coffee?
scenes.say_uz: Siz inglizcha gapirasizmi? U Toshkentda yashaydimi? Ular futbol o‘ynaydimi? U qahva ichadimi?

scenes.title: Qisqa javoblar
board: Do you like tea? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Does she work? — Yes, she does.
Can you swim? — Yes, I can.
scenes.say_native: Ha yoki yo‘q savoliga qisqa javob beramiz, va bunda savoldagi yordamchi fe’l qaytariladi. Do you like tea? — Yes, I do. Does she work? — Yes, she does. Are you ready? — Yes, I am. Can you swim? — Yes, I can. “Yes, I like” yoki “Yes, I work” deyish noto‘g‘ri. Yo‘q javobi uchun: No, I don’t, no, she doesn’t, no, I’m not. Ularni keyingi darsda batafsil o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Do you like tea? Yes, I do. Does she work? Yes, she does. Are you ready? Yes, I am. Can you swim? Yes, I can.
scenes.say_uz: Choy yoqadimi? Ha. U ishlaydimi? Ha. Tayyormisiz? Ha. Suza olasizmi? Ha.

scenes.title: Can bilan savol
board: You can swim. → Can you swim?
scenes.say_native: Can ham xuddi be kabi o‘zi yordamchi fe’l, shuning uchun uni egadan oldinga qo‘yamiz va do kerak emas. You can swim, can you swim? He can drive, can he drive? Can dan keyin fe’l doim oddiy shaklda turadi, he bilan ham s bo‘lmaydi: can he drive, can emas. O‘tgan darsda eshitgan “Can I try it on?” ham aynan shu tuzilma.
scenes.say: You can swim. Can you swim? He can drive. Can he drive? Can I try it on?
scenes.say_uz: Siz suza olasiz. Suza olasizmi? U mashina haydaydi. U mashina hayday oladimi? Kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Qisqa javob bering
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Savollarni eshiting va o‘zingiz haqingizda qisqa javob bering, ha yoki yo‘q, yordamchi fe’l bilan. Birinchi savol: siz talabamisiz. Ikkinchi: qahva yoqadimi. Uchinchi: ovqat pishira olasizmi. To‘rtinchi: do‘stingiz inglizcha gapiradimi. Masalan, “Yes, I am” yoki “No, I’m not”.
scenes.say: Are you a student? Do you like coffee? Can you cook? Does your friend speak English?
scenes.say_uz: Siz talabamisiz? Qahva yoqadimi? Ovqat pishira olasizmi? Do‘stingiz inglizcha gapiradimi?

scenes.title: Javob namunalari
board: Are you...? Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Do you...? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Can you...? Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
Does ...? Yes, he does. / No, she doesn't.
scenes.say_native: Javob yordamchi fe’lga bog‘liq. Are you bilan boshlangan savolga “Yes, I am”. Do you bilan boshlanganiga “Yes, I do”. Can you ga “Yes, I can”. Does your friend ga “Yes, he does” yoki “No, she doesn’t”. Sizning javoblaringiz haqiqatga qarab ha yoki yo‘q bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi yordamchi fe’lning savoldagi bilan mos kelishi.
scenes.say: Yes, I am. Yes, I do. Yes, I can. Yes, he does. No, she doesn't.
scenes.say_uz: Ha. Ha. Ha. Ha, u gapiradi. Yo‘q, u gapirmaydi.

scenes.title: Savol ohangi
scenes.say_native: Ohang ham muhim. Ha yoki yo‘q savollarida ovoz oxirida ko‘tariladi: are you ready? Bu britancha ingliz tilida ham, amerikachada ham shunday. So‘roq so‘zi bilan boshlangan savolda esa ovoz pastga tushadi: where do you live? Bu o‘zbek tiliga o‘xshaydi, chunki biz ham “-mi” li savolda ovozni ko‘taramiz. Tanlov savolida, masalan tea or coffee, birinchi variantda ko‘tarilib, oxirgisida tushadi.
scenes.say: Are you ready? Where do you live? Do you like tea? What is your name? Tea or coffee?
scenes.say_uz: Tayyormisiz? Qayerda yashaysiz? Choy yoqadimi? Ismingiz nima? Choymi yoki qahva?

scenes.title: Ohang bilan takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang va ohangga e’tibor bering. Birinchi savol ham yo‘q turi, ovozni oxirida ko‘taring: are you ready. Ikkinchisi so‘roq so‘zi bilan, ovozni tushiring: where do you live. Uchinchisi yana ha yoki yo‘q turida. To‘rtinchisi so‘roq so‘zi bilan. Ovoz bilan o‘ynang, sal bo‘rttirib aytish yordam beradi.
scenes.say: Are you ready? Where do you live? Do you like music? What is your name?
scenes.say_uz: Tayyormisiz? Qayerda yashaysiz? Musiqa yoqadimi? Ismingiz nima?

scenes.title: Ohang qoidasi
scenes.say_native: Qoida shunday. Ha yoki yo‘q savoli, ya’ni are you, do you, can you bilan boshlanadigan savol, ovoz ko‘tariladi. So‘roq so‘zi bilan boshlanadigan savol, ya’ni what, where, who, ovoz tushadi. Agar ohang noto‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, ba’zan suhbatdosh sizni tushunmaydi yoki savolingizni qo‘pol deb o‘ylashi mumkin. Shuning uchun ohangni so‘zlar kabi mashq qiling.
scenes.say: Yes or no question, your voice goes up. Question word, your voice goes down.
scenes.say_uz: Ha yoki yo‘q savolida ovoz ko‘tariladi. So‘roq so‘zida ovoz tushadi.

scenes.title: So‘roq so‘zlari: birinchi guruh
scenes.say_native: Endi so‘roq so‘zlari. What — nima? Where — qayerda yoki qayerga? Who — kim? When — qachon? Ular savolning boshiga qo‘yiladi. What is this? — bu nima? Where do you live? — qayerda yashaysiz? Who is that? — u kim? When is the lesson? — dars qachon? Where so‘zini “qayerda” va “qayerga” ma’nosida bir xil ishlatamiz: Where are you going?
scenes.say: What is this? Where do you live? Who is that? When is the lesson?
scenes.say_uz: Bu nima? Qayerda yashaysiz? U kim? Dars qachon?

scenes.title: So‘roq so‘zlari: ikkinchi guruh

examples.t: How many brothers do you have?

scenes.say_native: Yana to‘rtta. Why — nima uchun? How — qanday, qanaqa? How much — qancha, narx yoki sanalmaydigan miqdor uchun. How many — nechta, sanaladigan narsalar uchun. How many brothers do you have? How much is this? Why savoliga odatda “because” bilan javob beramiz: Why are you late? — Because I missed the bus. Because — chunki.
scenes.say: Why are you late? Because I missed the bus. How are you? How much is this? How many brothers do you have?
scenes.say_uz: Nega kechikdingiz? Chunki avtobusga ulgurmadim. Qalaysiz? Bu qancha turadi? Nechta akangiz bor?

scenes.title: Savol so‘zini toping
board: 3) ___ are you sad? — Because I am tired.
4) ___ is the shop open? — At nine.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Javobga qarab bo‘sh joyga mos so‘roq so‘zini ayting. Birinchi: javob Aziz. Ikkinchi: javob Samarqandda. Uchinchi: javob chunki men charchaganman. To‘rtinchi: javob soat to‘qqizda. Savol so‘zini aytib, to‘liq savolni tuzishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: The answer is Aziz. The answer is in Samarkand. The answer is because I am tired. The answer is at nine. Which question word?
scenes.say_uz: Javob: Aziz. Javob: Samarqandda. Javob: chunki charchaganman. Javob: soat to‘qqizda. Qaysi so‘roq so‘zi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ismni so‘rash uchun what: what is your name? Joyni so‘rash uchun where: where do you live? Sababni so‘rash uchun why: why are you sad? Vaqtni so‘rash uchun when: when is the shop open? Har bir so‘roq so‘zi javobning turini aniqlaydi: ism, joy, sabab, vaqt. Savol so‘zini tushunish uchun javob nimaga o‘xshashini o‘ylang.
scenes.say: What is your name? Where do you live? Why are you sad? When is the shop open?
scenes.say_uz: Ismingiz nima? Qayerda yashaysiz? Nega xafasiz? Do‘kon qachon ochiladi?

scenes.title: So‘roq so‘zli savolning tartibi
board: Wh-word + be + subject: Where is he?
scenes.say_native: Endi muhim formula. So‘roq so‘zi, keyin yordamchi fe’l, keyin ega, keyin asosiy fe’l: Where do you work? What does she want? Ya’ni oddiy ha yoki yo‘q savoliga so‘roq so‘zini boshiga qo‘shamiz. Be fe’li bilan: so‘roq so‘zi, be, ega: Where is he? What are these? Can bilan ham shunday: What can you cook?
scenes.say: Where do you work? What does she want? Where is he? What can you cook?
scenes.say_uz: Qayerda ishlaysiz? U nima xohlaydi? U qayerda? Nima pishira olasiz?

scenes.title: Who va what ega bo‘lganda
board: Who is she? / Who do you know?
scenes.say_native: Kichik istisno. Agar who yoki what savolning o‘zi egasi bo‘lsa, ya’ni “kim yashaydi” deb so‘rasangiz, do kerak emas: Who lives here? Bunda fe’l oddiy gapdagi kabi s oladi: lives. Lekin “kimni bilasiz” deb so‘rasangiz, ega “you” bo‘ladi va do qaytadi: Who do you know? Bu qoida hozircha tushunish uchun, lekin kundalik hayotda juda ko‘p uchraydi.
scenes.say: Who lives here? Who do you know? What happens now? What do you want?
scenes.say_uz: Bu yerda kim yashaydi? Siz kimni bilasiz? Hozir nima bo‘ladi? Nima xohlaysiz?

scenes.title: So‘roq so‘zli savoldagi xatolar
scenes.say_native: Savol so‘zi bilan eng ko‘p uchraydigan xatolar. Birinchisi: yordamchi fe’lni unutish, “Where you live?” Ikkinchisi: asosiy fe’lni egadan oldinga chiqarish, “Where lives she?” Bu ruscha yoki fransuzcha tartib emas, inglizchada so‘roq so‘zidan keyin yordamchi fe’l keladi. Uchinchisi: does va yana s, “Where does she lives?” To‘g‘risi: where does she live. Faqat yordamchi fe’l s oladi.
scenes.say: Not: Where you live? Say: Where do you live? Not: Where does she lives? Say: Where does she live?
scenes.say_uz: Where you live? emas. Where do you live? deng. Where does she lives? emas. Where does she live? deng.

scenes.title: So‘zlarni tartiblang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. So‘zlar aralashib ketgan, ularni to‘g‘ri savolga tartiblang. Birinchi: you, where, work, do. Ikkinchi: she, does, what, want. Uchinchi: your, is, name, what. To‘rtinchi: cook, can, you, what. Avval so‘roq so‘zini, keyin yordamchi fe’lni qo‘ying.
scenes.say: You, where, work, do. She, does, what, want. Your, is, name, what. Cook, can, you, what.
scenes.say_uz: Siz, qayerda, ishlaysiz, do. U, does, nima, xohlaydi. Sizning, ismingiz, nima. Pishira, olasiz, siz, nima.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: where do you work? Ikkinchi: what does she want? Uchinchi: what is your name? To‘rtinchi: what can you cook? Har birida tartib bir xil: so‘roq so‘zi, yordamchi fe’l, ega, keyin asosiy fe’l. Agar xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, dars boshidagi formulani qaytadan o‘qing.
scenes.say: Where do you work? What does she want? What is your name? What can you cook?
scenes.say_uz: Qayerda ishlaysiz? U nima xohlaydi? Ismingiz nima? Nima pishira olasiz?

scenes.title: Foydali kundalik savollar
scenes.say_native: Kundalik hayotda juda ko‘p eshitiladigan savollar: How old are you? — necha yoshdasiz? What do you do? — nima ish qilasiz, ya’ni kasbingiz nima? Where are you from? — qayerliksiz? How do you spell it? — buni qanday yozasiz? Eslang, “How old are you” savolida be ishlatiladi, “How many years do you have?” deyish xato bo‘ladi. Bu ham tarjimadan paydo bo‘ladigan keng tarqalgan xato.
scenes.say: How old are you? What do you do? Where are you from? How do you spell your name?
scenes.say_uz: Necha yoshdasiz? Nima ish qilasiz? Qayerliksiz? Ismingizni qanday yozasiz?

scenes.title: Dialog: yangi do‘st
board: B: In Tashkent. Do you live here?
A: Yes, I do. What do you do?
B: I'm a teacher. And you?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Ikki odam til kursida tanishmoqda. Savollarni diqqat bilan eshiting: qaysilari ha yoki yo‘q turida, qaysilari so‘roq so‘zi bilan. Keyin savollarga javob topasiz: Tom qayerda yashaydi, kasbi nima, farzandlari bormi va ular necha yoshda.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Dilya. Where do you live, Tom? I live in Leeds. Do you live here too? Yes, I do. What do you do? I'm a nurse. Do you have children? Yes, I have two. How old are they? Five and eight.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, men Dilyaman. Tom, qayerda yashaysiz? Men Lidsda yashayman. Siz ham shu yerda yashaysizmi? Ha. Nima ish qilasiz? Men hamshiraman. Farzandlaringiz bormi? Ha, ikkita. Ular necha yoshda? Besh va sakkiz.

scenes.title: Dialogni tushundingizmi?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: Tom qayerda yashaydi? Ikkinchi: uning kasbi nima? Uchinchi: uning farzandlari bormi? To‘rtinchi: ular necha yoshda? Javobni inglizcha qisqa ayting, masalan “He lives in…”.
scenes.say: Where does Tom live? What is his job? Does he have children? How old are they?
scenes.say_uz: Tom qayerda yashaydi? Uning kasbi nima? Uning farzandlari bormi? Ular necha yoshda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) Yes, he does. He has two.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Tom Lidsda yashaydi: in Leeds. U hamshira: he is a nurse. Uning farzandlari bor: yes, he does, ikkita. Ularning yoshi besh va sakkiz. Dialogdagi savollarga qarang: where do you live va what do you do so‘roq so‘zi bilan edi, do you live here va do you have children esa ha yoki yo‘q turida.
scenes.say: He lives in Leeds. He is a nurse. Yes, he does. They are five and eight.
scenes.say_uz: U Lidsda yashaydi. U hamshira. Ha, bor. Ular besh va sakkiz yoshda.

scenes.title: Tushunmasangiz: aniqlashtiruvchi savollar
scenes.say_native: Suhbat paytida tushunmasangiz, savol berish normal. Sorry, can you repeat that? — kechirasiz, takrorlay olasizmi? Can you speak more slowly, please? — sekinroq gapirasizmi? What does this word mean? — bu so‘z nimani anglatadi? Bu savollar ingliz tilini o‘rganishda sizning eng yaxshi do‘stingiz. Ular xafa qilmaydi, aksincha suhbatdosh sizni hurmat qiladi.
scenes.say: Sorry, can you repeat that? Can you speak more slowly, please? What does this word mean?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, takrorlay olasizmi? Sekinroq gapira olasizmi? Bu so‘z nima degani?

scenes.title: Dialog: ishga suhbat
board: B: In a bank. Does your sister work there?
A: No, she doesn't. She works in a school.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ikki hamkasb tushlik paytida gaplashadi. Tinglang va quyidagilarni aniqlang: Sem qayerda ishlaydi, opasi ham o‘sha yerda ishlaydimi, nega kechikdi va tushlik qachon. Savol shakllariga e’tibor bering, ayniqsa does bilan.
scenes.say: Where do you work, Sam? In a bank. Does your sister work there too? No, she doesn't. She works in a school. Why are you late today? Because my bus was late. When do you have lunch? At one o'clock.
scenes.say_uz: Sem, qayerda ishlaysiz? Bankda. Opangiz ham u yerda ishlaydimi? Yo‘q. U maktabda ishlaydi. Bugun nega kechikdingiz? Chunki avtobusim kech keldi. Tushlikni qachon qilasiz? Soat birda.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: Sem qayerda ishlaydi? Ikkinchi: uning opasi ham o‘sha yerda ishlaydimi? Uchinchi: Sem nega kechikdi? To‘rtinchi: tushlik qachon? Qisqa va aniq javob bering.
scenes.say: Where does Sam work? Does his sister work there? Why is Sam late? When is lunch?
scenes.say_uz: Sem qayerda ishlaydi? Opasi ham u yerda ishlaydimi? Sem nega kechikdi? Tushlik qachon?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) No, she doesn't. She works in a school.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Sem bankda ishlaydi. Uning opasi u yerda ishlamaydi: no, she doesn’t, u maktabda ishlaydi. Sem kechikdi, chunki avtobusi kech keldi: because his bus was late. Tushlik soat birda. Bu yerda “was” o‘tgan zamon shakli, uni keyinroq o‘rganamiz, hozir “because” dan keyin sabab kelishini bilsangiz yetarli.
scenes.say: In a bank. No, she doesn't. Because his bus was late. At one o'clock.
scenes.say_uz: Bankda. Yo‘q. Chunki avtobusi kech keldi. Soat birda.

scenes.title: Tabiiy nutq: kuchsiz shakllar
board: Where do you live? → 'Where d'you live?'
scenes.say_native: Tezroq gapirganda inglizlar yordamchi fe’llarni kuchsiz aytishadi. “Do you” deyarli “dyu” yoki “dye” bo‘lib eshitiladi: where do you live, bu “where d’you live” kabi. “Can you” ham “kyu” ga yaqin: can you help me. Bu sizga qiyin tuyulishi mumkin, chunki so‘zlar yutilib ketadi. Lekin eshitganingizda tushunish uchun bilib qo‘ying, o‘zingiz esa aniq gapirsangiz ham bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Where do you live? What do you do? Can you help me?
scenes.say_uz: Qayerda yashaysiz? Nima ish qilasiz? Menga yordam bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Tez va bog‘lab ayting
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolni avval sekin, keyin tezroq ayting. Do you va can you qismini yengil, kuchsiz aytishga harakat qiling. Where do you live. What do you do. Can you help me. Asosiy urg‘u so‘roq so‘ziga va ma’noli fe’lga tushadi: WHERE, LIVE, WHAT, DO.
scenes.say: Where do you live? What do you do? Can you help me?
scenes.say_uz: Qayerda yashaysiz? Nima ish qilasiz? Menga yordam bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Urg‘u
scenes.say_native: Hozir kuchli aytiladigan so‘zlar katta harf bilan. WHERE do you LIVE? WHAT do you DO? Can you HELP me? Yordamchi fe’l va olmosh kuchsiz, ma’noni tashiydigan so‘zlar kuchli. Bu ritm ingliz nutqining yuragi. Agar shunday aytsangiz, tez-tez tushunishadi, hatto ba’zi tovushlaringiz mukammal bo‘lmasa ham.
scenes.say: Where do you live? What do you do? Can you help me?
scenes.say_uz: Qayerda yashaysiz? Nima ish qilasiz? Menga yordam bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Xatoni toping
board: 4) How many years do you have?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Mana to‘rtta noto‘g‘ri savol. Har birini to‘g‘rilab ayting. Birinchi: where you live. Ikkinchi: does he works here. Uchinchi: you like pizza, bu yerda savol tuzilishi yo‘q. To‘rtinchi: how many years do you have. Nimani o‘zgartirish kerakligini o‘ylang.
scenes.say: Where you live? Does he works here? You like pizza? How many years do you have? Correct them.
scenes.say_uz: Where you live? Does he works here? You like pizza? How many years do you have? Ularni to‘g‘rilang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: where do you live, do unutilgan edi. Ikkinchi: does he work here, fe’lda s ortiqcha edi. Uchinchi: do you like pizza, do qo‘shildi. To‘rtinchi: how old are you, “nechta yilingiz bor” deb tarjima qilish xato. Eslatma: bu to‘rtta xato aynan o‘zbek tilida so‘zma-so‘z o‘ylashdan keladi.
scenes.say: Where do you live? Does he work here? Do you like pizza? How old are you?
scenes.say_uz: Qayerda yashaysiz? U shu yerda ishlaydimi? Pitsa yoqadimi? Necha yoshdasiz?

scenes.title: Yangi do‘stga savollar
board: 4 questions with where / what / why / how
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Tasavvur qiling, siz yangi do‘st bilan tanishdingiz. U haqida hozir sakkizta savol o‘ylang va baland ovozda ayting: to‘rttasi ha yoki yo‘q turida, to‘rttasi so‘roq so‘zlari bilan. Masalan, “Do you like music?” va “Where do you work?”. Yordamchi fe’l va ohangga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Now it is your turn. Ask a new friend eight questions. Four yes or no questions and four with a question word.
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Yangi do‘stingizga sakkizta savol bering. To‘rttasi ha yoki yo‘q savoli, to‘rttasi so‘roq so‘zi bilan.

scenes.title: Namuna savollar
board: Do you like music? Can you cook?
Are you from Tashkent? Does your sister live here?
Where do you work? What do you do at weekends?
Why do you learn English? How do you come here?
scenes.say_native: Mana namunalar. Ha yoki yo‘q: Do you like music? Can you cook? Are you from Tashkent? Does your sister live here? So‘roq so‘zi bilan: Where do you work? What do you do at weekends? Why do you learn English? How do you come here? Sizning savollaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin yordamchi fe’l, ega, fe’l tartibi va ohang shu bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Do you like music? Can you cook? Where do you work? What do you do at weekends? Why do you learn English?
scenes.say_uz: Musiqa yoqadimi? Ovqat pishira olasizmi? Qayerda ishlaysiz? Dam olish kunlari nima qilasiz? Nega ingliz tilini o‘rganasiz?

scenes.title: Darsni yakunlaymiz
board: Be / can: move to the front
Other verbs: Do / Does + subject + base verb
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz. Be va can bilan fe’lni egadan oldinga o‘tkazamiz: are you, can you. Boshqa fe’llar bilan do yoki does qo‘shamiz va asosiy fe’l oddiy shaklda qoladi. So‘roq so‘zi, yordamchi fe’l, ega, fe’l: where do you live. Ha yoki yo‘q savollarida ovoz ko‘tariladi, so‘roq so‘zida tushadi. Qisqa javobda yordamchi fe’l qaytariladi: yes, I do. Barakalla!
scenes.say: Be and can go first. With other verbs use do or does. Question word, helper, subject, verb. Yes or no, up. Question word, down.
scenes.say_uz: Be va can birinchi keladi. Boshqa fe’llar bilan do yoki does. So‘roq so‘zi, yordamchi fe’l, ega, fe’l. Ha yoki yo‘q: ko‘tariladi. So‘roq so‘zi: tushadi.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Write 10 questions for a new friend
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi. Yangi do‘stga berish uchun o‘nta savol yozing: to‘rttasi ha yoki yo‘q turida, oltitasi so‘roq so‘zlari bilan, kamida to‘rtta turli so‘roq so‘zi ishlating. Tekshiring: har bir savolda yordamchi fe’l bor, does dan keyin fe’lda s yo‘q, oxirida savol belgisi turibdi. Keyin ularni baland ovozda to‘g‘ri ohang bilan o‘qing. Keyingi darsda inkor gaplarni o‘rganamiz. Ko‘rishguncha!
scenes.say: Write ten questions for a new friend. See you next time. Bye!
scenes.say_uz: Yangi do‘stingiz uchun o‘nta savol yozing. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz. Xayr!

homework_uz: Yangi do‘stingizga berish uchun o‘nta savol yozing: to‘rttasi ha yoki yo‘q savoli, oltitasi so‘roq so‘zlari bilan (kamida to‘rtta turli so‘roq so‘zi). Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir savolda yordamchi fe’l bor, does dan keyin fe’lda s yo‘q, oxirida savol belgisi turibdi va ularni to‘g‘ri ohang bilan o‘qiy olasiz.

quiz.q: Make a question: 'She is a teacher.'
quiz.why_uz: Be fe’li egadan oldinga chiqadi: Is she a teacher?
You bilan do ishlatiladi: Do you like tea?
Does dan keyin fe’l oddiy shaklda: Does he work here?

quiz.q: Choose the correct short answer to 'Do you speak English?'
quiz.why_uz: Qisqa javobda yordamchi fe’l qaytariladi: Yes, I do.

options: How many years do you have?
quiz.why_uz: Ingliz tilida be fe’li bilan: How old are you?
Does dan keyin fe’l oddiy shaklda: live.

quiz.q: In a yes/no question, your voice usually...
quiz.why_uz: Ha yoki yo‘q savolida ovoz oxirida ko‘tariladi.

quiz.q: 'Why are you late?' — Which answer is natural?
quiz.why_uz: Why savoliga because bilan sabab aytiladi.
